g.text: The system shall inhibit leg actuation until pilot
The system shall provide an operator-requested
protective stop with a defined, analyzed safe
behavior for each operating mode that does not
The UAV shall be prevented from rotor startup
while mechanically retained, except under an
The system shall detect loss or staleness of
essential actuator and posture feedback and
transition to a documented degraded state.
The docking interface shall report a positively
UAV launch and recovery shall be inhibited
outside a verified operational envelope of
walker posture, motion and dock state.
The walker shall provide lockable isolation and
The walker shall limit commanded motion and
payload to a verified static and dynamic
stability envelope, including a terrain slope limit
of 20 degrees with the centre of mass no more
than 0.12 m ahead of the stance foot, and
provide pilot protection in a fall or overturn.
The walker shall hold its posture without
supply or command on loss of actuator supply,
with load holding engaging in less than the
free-fall time from the highest operating
The protective stop path shall achieve its
defined safe behavior without depending on the
mission, motion and balance control software.
The protective stop shall begin its defined safe
behavior within the reaction time allocated by
hazard analysis for each operating mode.
UAV rotor arming shall require a positively
confirmed unretained dock state reported over
On loss of the integration link the UAV shall
hold for a set time and then land in place, and
shall not return to the dock or descend within
the pilot keep-out without a recovery permit
If the series-hybrid power alternative is
retained, the walker shall isolate the traction
or over-current independently of the motion
If the series-hybrid power alternative is
retained, a protective stop or detected fall shall
shut off fuel to the engine-generator and stop
Each ankle actuator shall deliver at least 1.5 m
g L_foot of torque at full actuator supply and
at least 0.6 m g L_foot at the supply at which
load holding engages, and each knee actuator
at least 26.5 kN m at full supply
reference layout CL-05), so that a loss of
supply inside the operating envelope does not
tip the walker before load holding engages.
The walker shall inhibit walking until both
manipulator arms are confirmed stowed and
locked, or locked in the carry pose under the
hold the arms in that pose until walking has
stopped, and shall inhibit manipulation while the
exclusion zone around the arms' reach is not
The walker shall provide a controlled lowered
posture for ingress and egress, with the cockpit
floor at or below a defined height, entered and
left at a controlled speed only while the area
under and around the pod and legs is confirmed
clear, and shall inhibit walking while an access
The walker shall permit walking with a payload
only while the payload is confirmed secured,
both arms are locked in a defined carry pose
and payload mass and centre of gravity are
within defined limits, and shall then limit
walking speed, step height and terrain slope to
defined loaded values inside the stability
The pilot shall be able to leave the walker from
the standing posture without platform power and
without kneeling, through an exit other than the
front opening, with a descent aid and handholds
that keep three points of contact to the ground.
The pilot display shall mark UAV imagery,
position and telemetry as not valid when they
fail validity checks, and as not current when
they have not updated within a defined time, so
that they are never shown as current and valid
The dock shall charge the UAV battery only
when the aircraft is seated and confirmed, shall
stop charging on over-voltage, over-current or
software, and shall keep its charging contacts
de-energised and shrouded whenever no UAV is
seated or charging has been isolated for
Maintenance tasks on the walker above a
defined working height shall be done from a
guarded access platform or stand, or, where no
platform can reach, with fall arrest attached to
rated anchor points provided on the walker.
Trained crew shall be able to release the hatch
and the pilot restraint from outside the walker
without platform power, and to remove an
incapacitated pilot from a standing, kneeling or
fallen walker within a defined time, with fall

svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/requirements_readme.py from requirements/SYS-*.yaml, safety/hazards/ and architecture/item-definition.yaml. Candidate requirements: not baselined, verified or accepted.

g.text: Terms: BMS = battery management system · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SPEC-nnn = simulation parameter spec

record (sim/spec/) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK

= UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT =

battery pack, BMS and contactors (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor (alternative B) · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing
· SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
